blocks.text: Parallel plate capacitor do conductors se banta hai jo aik doosre ke qareeb rakhe hon aur jin ke darmiyan vacuum, hawa ya koi aur insulator ho; is insulator ko dielectric kehte hain. Aam taur par conductors parallel (mutawazi, aamne saamne barabar faasle par) plates hoti hain, is liye isay parallel plate capacitor kehte hain. Jab plates ko V volt ki battery se joren (Fig. 16.6) to plates ke darmiyan V volt ka potential difference ban jata hai. Battery apne positive terminal se juri plate par +Q aur negative terminal se juri plate par −Q charge rakh deti hai. Har plate par charge ki magnitude (miqdar) Q hai. Experiment (tajurba) se pata chalta hai ke:

blocks.alt: Circuit ke oopar wale taar mein parallel plate capacitor, plates +Q (peeli) aur -Q (neeli), d faasle par. Neeche wale taar mein voltage V ki battery (baen taraf +) aur switch S. Oopar ke taar par teer charging current ki direction dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.6: Switch S ke zariye battery V se jura parallel plate capacitor (kitab ki Figure 16.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text_alt: Q ∝ V or Q = CV or C = Q/V   (16.28)

blocks.text: Proportionality constant C capacitor ki capacitance hai. Aage dekhenge ke yeh plates ki geometry (banawat) aur un ke darmiyan medium par depend karti hai. Yeh capacitor ki charge store karne ki ability (salahiyat) ka measure (naap) hai.

blocks.title: Capacitor ki capacitance
blocks.text: Capacitor ki capacitance woh charge hai jo aik plate par dena parta hai taake us plate ka potential doosri plate ke muqable aik volt barh jaye.
Capacitance ki SI unit coulomb per volt hai, jise aam taur par mashhoor English scientist Michael Faraday ke naam par farad (F) kehte hain.

blocks.title: Farad
blocks.text: Capacitor ki capacitance aik farad hai agar parallel plate capacitor ki aik plate ko aik coulomb charge dene se dono plates ke darmiyan aik volt ka potential difference ban jaye.
Parallel plate capacitor ki capacitance

Yani area A barhane se capacitance barhti hai aur faasla d barhane se ghatti hai. Agar plates ke darmiyan relative permittivity εᵣ wala insulating material (maddah), yani dielectric, rakh dein to capacitance εᵣ guna ho jati hai. Aksar capacitors mein koi dielectric hota hai, is liye εᵣ ko dielectric constant bhi kehte hain.
Dielectric dalne ka asar is tajurbe se samajh aata hai:

Charged capacitor ki plates ko voltmeter se joren (Fig. 16.7 a); meter ki sui ka deflection (jhukao) plates ka potential difference batata hai. Plates ke darmiyan dielectric dalne par reading gir jati hai, yani potential difference kam ho gaya (Fig. 16.7 b). C = Q/V mein Q wahi hai (capacitor kisi battery se nahi jura) aur V kam hua, is liye C barh gayi. Ab Eq. 16.32 yeh ban jati hai:

blocks.text: Yeh equation (16.33) batati hai ke capacitance plates ke area, plates ke faasle aur darmiyan wale medium par depend karti hai.

blocks.title: Dielectric constant
blocks.text: Dielectric constant us capacitance ka, jab plates ke darmiyan insulating material ho, us capacitance se ratio (nisbat) hai jab darmiyan vacuum (ya hawa) ho.

Potential difference kam kyun hota hai? Wajah dielectric ke atoms ka polarization hai. Dielectric insulator hai: is mein free electrons nahi hote, sab electrons apne positive nucleus se bandhe hote hain. Jab aise atom par electric field lage to us ke electrons nucleus ke muqable thora sa field ki opposite direction (ulti taraf) mein khisak jate hain (Fig. 16.7 c). Isay dielectric ka polarization kehte hain aur aise distorted (bigre hue) atom ko polarized kehte hain.

Jab dielectric slab ko do opposite (ulte) charge wali plates ke darmiyan rakhein to plates ka field us ke atoms ko polarize kar deta hai (Fig. 16.7 d). Result (natija) yeh ke slab ki un surfaces par charge aa jata hai jo plates ko chhoo rahi hain, aur yeh charge saath wali plate ke charge ka ulat hota hai (+ plate ke saath −, − plate ke saath +). Plates ka apna charge wahi rehta hai, lekin yeh ulte charges us ka asar kam kar dete hain, goya plates par charge kam ho gaya. Is liye plates ke darmiyan field aur potential difference ghat jate hain.

blocks.alt: Do hisse. (c) Field ke baghair atom: nucleus electron cloud ke centre par; field mein (daen teer) wahi atom: nucleus cloud ke centre se hat gaya. (d) + plate (baen) aur - plate (daen) ke darmiyan dielectric slab: molecules dipoles hain jin ka - sira + plate ki taraf; + plate ke saath wali surface par - charges aur - plate wali surface par + charges.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.7 (c, d): (c) Electric field ke baghair aur field mein atom; (d) charged plates ke darmiyan polarised dielectric (kitab ki Figure 16.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki (d) mein charges slab mein qataron ki shakal mein chhape hain (oopar ⊕ aur neeche -), jo book ke text se mel nahi khata. Sahi picture: har molecule ka electron cloud field ke ulat khisakta hai, is liye + plate ke saath wali surface par negative (-) aur - plate ke saath wali surface par positive (+) charge aata hai. Yeh charges plates ka asar kam karte hain, is liye field aur potential difference ghatte hain aur capacitance barhti hai.

blocks.prompt: Parallel plate capacitor ki plates ka area 0.02 m² aur hawa mein faasla 1.0 mm hai. Is ki capacitance nikalein, aur εᵣ = 5 wala dielectric dalne ke baad bhi.
blocks.explanation: C_vac = Aε₀/d = (0.02 m²)(8.85 × 10⁻¹² F m⁻¹)/(1.0 × 10⁻³ m) = 1.77 × 10⁻¹⁰ F = 177 pF. Dielectric ke saath C_med = εᵣC_vac = 5 × 177 pF = 885 pF.

blocks.text: Short summary (mukhtasar khulasa)

items: Q = CV; C plates ki geometry aur medium par depend karti hai.
C_vac = Aε₀/d; C_med = Aε₀εᵣ/d; εᵣ = C_med/C_vac.
Dielectric polarize ho kar field kamzor karta hai: V girta, C barhti.
